name: write_symbol
description: Guarded write path (one symbol) — vs edit_batch: index-aware with version/lock/undo, for symbol-level refactors. Read first (read_symbol) for base_version. 含双引号/反斜杠的字符串参数注意 JSON 转义一致性（全串统一转义或改用中文引号），否则客户端参数解析失败。

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

symbol_id.description: Stable symbol id (preferred). Read it from read_symbol output.

name.description: Symbol name (used with file_path when symbol_id unknown)

base_version.description: REQUIRED: version from read_symbol. Conflict anchor.

symbol.description: { body_hash, signature_hash } — symbol hashes from read_symbol

content.description: New content (full symbol or body per boundary)

old_string.description: Exact text to replace (must be unique in scope)

boundary.description: full (default): replace whole symbol. body: keep signature line, replace the rest.

preserve_decorators.description: Warn if content drops decorators that exist above the symbol (default true)

dry_run.description: Validate and produce diff without writing (default false)

allow_unsafe_no_base.description: Bypass base_version requirement (audited). Only for deliberate full-file overwrites.

block_on_validation_error.description: Block write if validation fails (default false)
